sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Imagines he must starve. Headache, with
vomiting. Crusta lactea. Dandruff.

sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
White mucus, purulent scabs. Superficial
ulcer. Trachoma.

sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Chronic, catarrhal conditions of the middle
ear. Glands about the ear swollen. Snapping and
noises in the ear.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Catarrh; phlegm white, thick. Vault of
pharynx covered with adherent crusts. Stuffy cold.
Nosebleed. [Arn.; Bry.]

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Aphthae; thrush; white ulcers in mouth.
Swollen glands about jaw and neck. Coating of tongue
grayish-white , dryish, or slimy.

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Follicular tonsillitis. Tonsils inflamed; en-
larged so much, can hardly breathe. Grayish patches
or spots in the throat and tonsils. Adherent crusts in
vault of pharynx. “Hospital” sore throat.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Fatty or rich food causes indigestion.
Vomiting of white, opaque mucus; water gathers in the

sections.label: mouth
sections.text:
Pain in the stomach, with constipation. Buli-
mia; hunger disappears by drinking water.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Abdominal tenderness and swelling.
Flatulence. Thread-worms, causing itching at the anus.

430

sections.label: Stool
sections.text:
Constipation; light-colored stools. Diar-
rhoea, after fatty food; clay-colored, white, or slimy
stools. Dysentery; purging, with slimy stools. Ilccmor-
rhoids: bleeding; blood dark and thick; fibrinous,
clotted.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Menstruation too late or suppressed,
checked or too early; excessive discharge; dark-clottcd,
or tough, black blood, like tar. [Plat.] Leucorrhoea;
discharge of milky-white mucus, thick, non-irritating,
bland. Morning sickness, wJth vomiting of white
phlegm. Bunches in breast feel quite soft and are
tender.

Respiratory Organs. — Loss of voice; hoarseness.
Asthma, with gastric derangements; mucus white and
hard to cough up. Loud, noisy stomach cough ; cough
short, acute, and spasmodic, like whooping-cough ; ex-
pectoration thick and white. Rattling sounds of air
passing through thick, tenacious mucus in the bronchi;
difficiilt to cough up.

Back ahd Extremities. — Rheumatic fever ; exudation
and swelling around the joints. Rheumatic pains felt
only during motion, or increased by it. Nightly rheu-
matic pains; worse from warmth of bed; lightning-like
from small of back to feet; must get out of bed and
sit up. Hands get stiff while writing.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Acne, erythema, and eczema, with vesicles
containing thick, white contents. Dry, flour-like scales
on the skin. [Arsenic.]

Modalities, — Worse, rich food, fats, motion.
